content:
Vice President JD Vance on Monday appeared incapable of taking accountability for the four-hour nationwide flight shutdown but didn’t just blame Friday’s unnerving debacle on a lack of funding — but on the Democratic Party’s supposed “obsession with men in women’s sports.”

Vance appeared on Fox News and echoed Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy’s demand for billions in taxpayer dollars to upgrade U.S. aviation systems.

“Laura, we could absolutely do this with Democrats in the new Congress if they set to side their ridiculous obsession with men in women’s sports and did what they said they would do, which is focus on affordability and focus on rebuilding our infrastructure,” Vance said Monday.

Host Laura Ingraham wasn’t buying his line that the Federal Aviation Administration is running on shoddy equipment because Congress hasn’t provided “the resources” to fix it, reminding Vance that his Republican administration has “been in charge the last two years.”

The GOP holds a majority in the House and Senate under President Donald Trump, and while that will soon change after the Democratic midterms landslide, critics pushed back against Vance’s excuses. But others were most outraged by his transgender quip.

“There is 1 party obsessed with transgender people and it isn’t democrats,” one X user wrote Monday, with another person commenting: “so they just doubling down on the distracting garbage that got them unelected in the first place.”

Republicans have long made transgender athletes a main focus of their politics. Democrats have made a “focus on affordability” a central issue, meanwhile, alongside concerns over Trump’s war on Iran and alleged corruption.

Another person noted, “Republicans think about trans people more than trans people think about trans people. At some point, it stops looking like a political position and starts looking like a personal obsession.”

Vance has touched on the matter excessively in recent years, baselessly warning that Democrats hope to “fund gender reassignment surgeries” for undocumented immigrants — and weirdly alleging socialism in America means “you want boys to play in girls’ sports.”

The vice president’s suggestion on Monday that Democrats or transgender people were to blame for outdated FAA equipment or the nationwide flight shutdown, which affected more than 1.5 million passengers on roughly 11,000 flights, did not go over well on X.
